notes: Verified Tsuyoshi Yamamoto / Greater Tokyo catch-up discovery. The finale of the roughly five-year Plaza Afternoon Jazz series combines Masahiko Satoh's trio with Keisuke Ohta and a Yamamoto/Kagawa/Osumi trio augmented by Takuya Osumi; the special two-part context raises it above a routine Yamamoto club date.

events.artist: Masahiko Satoh Trio feat. Keisuke Ohta + Tsuyoshi Yamamoto Trio
events.subtitle: Plaza Afternoon Jazz Vol.21 FINAL
events.factual_description: The final performance of Kawasaki Shimin Plaza's roughly five-year Plaza Afternoon Jazz series is a two-part bill: Masahiko Satoh Trio featuring violinist Keisuke Ohta, followed by Tsuyoshi Yamamoto Trio with Hiroshi Kagawa and Toshio Osumi plus alto saxophonist Takuya Osumi. The official venue lists doors at 13:30 and a 14:00 start on October 3, 2026.

provenance.note: Date, start time, venue, series-finale context, full lineup and authorized ticket seller verified against the official Kawasaki Shimin Plaza event page. Apple Music links verified as exact album pages.

en.why_it_matters: This is considerably more than another Yamamoto club date: Masahiko Satoh, Keisuke Ohta, Hideaki Kanazawa and Shun Ishiwaka open the afternoon before Yamamoto's core trio with Kagawa and Toshio Osumi closes a five-year concert series, augmented by Takuya Osumi. The finale context and the intergenerational Japanese-jazz bill make the event unusually dense with instrumental identity and improvisational history.
en.trip_verdict: S within Greater Tokyo/Kanto. Build the afternoon around the Kawasaki trip: the stacked two-part finale is worth crossing the metro area for, though it is not by itself a transpacific destination.

es.why_it_matters: Esto es bastante más que otra fecha de club de Yamamoto: Masahiko Satoh, Keisuke Ohta, Hideaki Kanazawa y Shun Ishiwaka abren la tarde antes de que el núcleo Yamamoto-Kagawa-Toshio Osumi cierre una serie de conciertos de cinco años, aumentado por Takuya Osumi. El contexto de final y el cruce generacional del jazz japonés concentran una cantidad poco común de identidad instrumental e historia de improvisación.
es.trip_verdict: S dentro de Greater Tokyo/Kanto. Vale construir la tarde alrededor de la escapada a Kawasaki: el final en dos partes justifica cruzar el área metropolitana, aunque por sí solo no es destino transpacífico.
